pages.title: A Copper Spark
pages.text: For lightning dragons: boosts direct human-form combat breath damage with gathered sparks.

pages.title: Crafting the Device
pages.text: Place the copper block in the center, with a copper ingot on either side. Put the chain above it and the lightning rod below; leave the corners empty.

pages.title: A Lightning Accessory
pages.text: Only a lightning dragon can wear this device. Place it in your companion's accessory slot before setting out.
